outcome: blood loss after abortion at 2 h
cohort: 204 second-trimester pregnant women with prior cesareans
finding: The four regimens of inducing second-trimester pregnancy termination are all effective for women with prior cesareans, but the use of a transcervical Cook double-balloon catheter may reduce risks caused by misoprostol.
